Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the death dates, concluding that Georges Lautner (d. 2013-11-22) died before Lesley Selander (d. 1979-12-05) by focusing on the month/day ordering (“November 22 precedes December 5”) and ignoring the year. This logical oversight led to the incorrect final answer; in fact, Selander’s 1979 death is earlier, so Knights of the Range should have been the correct film.
